podcast.body: This song replaced "New York City Cops" on the US version of "Is This It." The swap was made for the North American market because the original track was considered critical of first responders, and its release in October 2001 was too close to the 9/11 events. "So, American copies feature another track called When It Started. Again, probably wise."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song was used to replace "New York City Cops" on the US CD and original vinyl releases of *Is This It*. The change was made after the 9/11 attacks, as the original song's lyrics were considered insensitive. "acabaría reemplazando esa canción por buen instarte."

srcs.episode: The Strokes: Is this it y su portada censurada.
